description.zh: 写下想问的事，抽韦特塔罗，一键把牌面发到对话框交给 AI 解读。支持单张、时间流三张、选择十字三种牌阵与正逆位。
description.en: Ask a question, draw Waite tarot cards, and send the reading to the AI chat for interpretation.

description.zh: 让 AI 直接抽塔罗牌并拿到牌面结果用于解读。
description.en: Let the AI draw tarot cards and receive the result for interpretation.
